violations.text: The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
Employees were observed donning gloves without washing their hands. Food employees must wash their hands before putting on gloves. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Bar employees were observed touching ready to eat food (fruit wedge) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Bar staff and PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

A funnel and spray bottles were observed on/in the bar handwashing sink; an a/c drain tube was observed draining into the kitchen handwashing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Funnel and bottle were removed. PIC to have a/c drain tube moved to direct connection with waste pipe. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2026
The cutting board on the small prep unit was observed with food debris. Board taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Working containers of multiple sauces are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2026

Single service items (pizza boxes and cups) are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the kitchen and bar areas. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets (large prep unit) were observed in poor repair. A wood and plastic cutting board were observed deeply scratched, scored, and cracked. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the small prep unit have an accumulation of food residue (Staff cleaned during inspection). Water was pooling on bottom shelving of bar coolers. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. PIC stated gaskets have been ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The auto-drain between cycles of the dish machine was not cycling properly during inspection due to angle of drain tube. PIC contacted contractor during inspection to have drain hose adjusted. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the bar dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Wood is used in the construction of the dish machine supports in the bar area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of biofilm debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026
